title: Manage one worktree per attempt
objective: Manage one worktree per attempt. Implement only this observable slice using the frozen schema and port contracts.

acceptance_criteria.description: Idempotently create owned task/integration worktrees and record actual base and branch
acceptance_criteria.verification: TASK-011 owned behavior tests and structured handoff evidence

acceptance_criteria.description: Refuse unsafe cleanup of dirty, untracked, live-leased or unmanaged worktrees
acceptance_criteria.verification: TASK-011 failure-case tests and structured handoff evidence

output_contracts: worktrees/lifecycle public behavior described by this task acceptance; use predeclared ports
size_rationale: One component outcome with two bounded acceptance checks; no central registry edits. Split further through isolation review if implementation exceeds this estimate.
out_of_scope: Changing shared contracts without a new prerequisite task
Production provider integration, paid services, remote publication and product-scope changes
handoff_requirements: Exact base/commit and verified changed paths
Actual test command evidence and acceptance mapping
Public interface/dependency notes, deviations and risks
